sources.quote: SC-BR220-YS,BR-220,Yield strength Rp0.2 at least 250 MPa,250
Not interchangeable with EN AW-6061: different alloy, lower yield.

findings.why: The drawing in force (rev C) requires EN AW-6082-T6 and SC-BR220-YS requires yield of at least 250 MPa. EN AW-6061-T6 is a different alloy with a typical yield of 240 MPa, so it does not meet the drawing material or the special characteristic. The part card says the two are not interchangeable. The FMEA rates this failure mode at severity 9.

sources.quote: The supplier shall obtain written approval from Aurelia (PPAP resubmission) before shipping parts

findings.why: BR-220 belongs to program PRG-X, which is an Aurelia program. Aurelia manual revision 4, which replaces revision 3, requires written approval (PPAP resubmission) for a change of material. It also requires notification at least 90 days before implementation. No approval or notification from Aurelia is in the documents, and no deviation covers this change.
